description: This file contains unit tests for the modem simulator service, including tests for ICC card status, SIM IO, network registration, call handling, SMS, and other modem functionalities. It uses Google Test framework and mocks interactions with modem commands.

classes.name: ModemServiceTest
classes.description: A Google Test fixture class for testing the modem simulator service, providing setup and utility methods for sending commands and reading responses.

methods.name: SetUpTestSuite
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including creating configuration files, socket pairs, and modem simulator instance.

methods.name: TearDownTestSuite
methods.description: Cleans up the test environment, deleting allocated objects and removing temporary directories.

methods.name: SendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command string to the modem simulator, optionally with a prefix for response filtering.

methods.name: ReadCommandResponse
methods.description: Reads the response from the modem simulator, parsing for final success/error responses or intermediate responses.

methods.name: IsFinalResponseSuccess
methods.description: Checks if a response string matches any of the final success responses.

methods.name: IsFinalResponseError
methods.description: Checks if a response string matches any of the final error responses.

methods.name: IsIntermediateResponse
methods.description: Checks if a response string matches the expected prefix for intermediate responses.

methods.name: openLogicalChannel
methods.description: Creates and opens a logical channel with the given name, returning the channel number.
